Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Bringing a preview up 2 days before the release weekend showing a card
that isn't even in the set (when it's already shipped). Delivery got
delayed and still there are wrong rules in the starters and 2
uncommons dissappeared form the set (no hunting ground for you evil
toreador) and the number of new cards is not the same as announced.

WW really needs some serious Quality Assurance going...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The former, mostly. One new uncommon was erroneously omitted from the uncommon
sheet, as described on the preview page. But the original 20/20/20 figure was
the main error; no printing error involved there. The figure was initially set
to be 15/15/15, but as I was developing the cards, I found I wanted a few more
in there so I tried to stretch it to 20/20/20. I didn't reach that goal, but the
figure leaped from my tongue when I was asked about the number of new cards.
